executive_summary: The Environmental Protection Board (EPB) of the City of Stamford held its regular meeting on July 16, 2026, via Zoom. The meeting focused on reviewing and approving minutes from previous meetings, discussing new applications, and addressing enforcement and other business matters. Key decisions included approving several applications and deferring others pending further information. The board also discussed the need for external consultation on vernal pool studies and considered waiving application fees under specific conditions.

key_topics.summary: The board reviewed and approved the minutes from the May 21 and June 18 meetings.
The board accepted three new applications for review and discussed the potential need for public hearings and external consultations.
The board discussed ongoing enforcement issues and other business, including a request for an extension on a deer fence removal order.

decisions_and_votes.description: Approval of May 21 and June 18 meeting minutes
Deferral of application 2026-19 pending further information
Granting a 60-day extension for deer fence removal at 161 North Stamford Road

action_items.item: Review and update the mitigation planting guidelines
Arrange for external consultation on vernal pool study
Communicate extension decision to property owner at 161 North Stamford Road
